meta.title: x/tools/gopls: incorrect metadata invalidation when changing package name
meta.fix_ref: golang/tools@556c550a3816 (internal/lsp/cache: invalidate packages that have added files; CL 401795, 'Fixes golang/go#52500')
meta.build_notes: go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@<version> with the local Go (go1.27.1), which builds both; the server runs the local go command. v0.8.3 was tagged 2022-04-07, the fix merged 2022-05-02, v0.8.4 was tagged 2022-05-13.
meta.notes: When a file's package name changed, gopls invalidated only the packages previously containing the file, not the package it moved into; after x_test -> x -> x_test the file was left in no package. The fix invalidates every known package of the directory for new files and package-name changes.

files.note: the go.mod of the fix's regression test TestChangeTestVariant_Issue52500 (the issue describes the steps but gives no code)
the file main_test.go of the fix's regression test TestChangeTestVariant_Issue52500: an x_test package (main_test) whose second file uses a declaration of the toggled file
the file other_test.go of the fix's regression test TestChangeTestVariant_Issue52500: the file whose package clause is toggled

repro.steps: The issue's steps: move a file from package x_test to package x, wait, then move it back to package x_test; reported: the file is then contained in no package. Here: open other_test.go, change its package clause from main_test to main (line 0, characters 8-17), let the server settle, change it back to main_test. Probe: the diagnostics of other_test.go and definition on Server in 'func (Server) Foo()' (line 4, character 6) are compared with a fresh session on the same (restored) text and a fresh control.
